## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, and gaunt woman with sharp angles and no curves, featuring sallow cheeks and hard, work-worn hands. Her hair, which is twisted tightly into a hard little knot behind her head, is dark with gray streaks that have grown grayer over time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P39](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0039)_

## Personality

A sensible, self-contained, and practical individual, Marilla maintains a strictly orderly home and approaches life in a grounded manner. She is determined in her decisions and takes a highly critical, strict approach to raising a child, firmly believing in imparting moral lessons and drilling a tranquil disposition into her charge as a conscientious duty. Though naturally reserved, undemonstrative, and reluctant to admit her pride or put her deep affection into words, her demeanor has notably mellowed over time. Additionally, she is celebrated for her skill in making homemade currant wine.

## History

Marilla Cuthbert, who had resided at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for sixty years, initially agreed with her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to adopt an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to assist with farm labor. However, she was shocked when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) instead brought home a young girl named [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Although Marilla intended to return [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), she reconsidered after learning about the child's harsh upbringing and witnessing Mrs. Blewett's severe nature. Deciding to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Marilla committed to educating the girl in household duties and religious practices. Over time, her affection for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grew, particularly after an incident where she falsely accused [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her inherited amethyst brooch, only to find the item pinned to her own shawl. Marilla supported Anne's academic development, encouraging her enrollment in Miss Stacy's Queen's entrance class and celebrating her eventual pass list success and Avery scholarship victory. Following Matthew's sudden death from a bank failure and facing severe eye failure of her own, Marilla contemplated selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) forfeited her college scholarship to remain in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to teach and save the farm. Shortly thereafter, Marilla took in her dying relative's orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, whose uncle later left funds for their long-term care at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). After another neighbor passed away, Marilla invited her forty-five-year long neighbor, Mrs.

## Quotes

> "I’d never dream of taking a girl to bring up. I wonder at Mrs. Alexander Spencer for doing it. But there, she wouldn’t shrink from adopting a whole orphan asylum if she took it into her head."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0029)

> "I don’t feel as if I wanted any more children to look after than I’ve got at present. You’re problem enough in all conscience. What’s to be done with you I don’t know. Matthew is a most ridiculous man."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P25](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0025)

> “There, there, Marilla, you can have your own way,” said Matthew reassuringly. “Only be as good and kind to her as you can without spoiling her. I kind of think she’s one of the sort you can do anything with if you only get her to love you.”
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)

> "Matthew Cuthbert, I’m astonished at you. You know that Anne’s behavior was dreadful, and yet you take her part! I suppose you’ll be saying next thing that she oughtn’t to be punished at all!"
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)

> "She’ll have her meals regular, and I’ll carry them up to her myself. But she’ll stay up there until she’s willing to apologize to Mrs. Lynde, and that’s final, Matthew."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P4](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla took in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bring her up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), initially expecting an orphan boy instead. Though shocked by the mix-up and hesitant at first, Marilla chose to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rather than place her with a harsh neighbor, undertaking her moral and religious education. Over time, Marilla becomes a mentor, good friend, and affectionate guardian to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), supporting her through childhood mistakes and growing deeply attached to her despite Anne's dramatic outbursts.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), +22 more_

### [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Marilla lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who shared the home until his sudden death following a bank failure. Though Marilla was practical and firm while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) was quiet and soft-hearted, they jointly decided to adopt an orphan and maintain their household together. When Marilla initially wanted to return [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Matthew's quiet advocate for keeping the girl ultimately helped shape Marilla's decision.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), +30 more_

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Marilla and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) are longstanding neighbors and friends who regularly visit each other to share local news and advice. Though they have contrasting personalities and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) often offers unsolicited opinions or sharp criticism, Marilla values her input, such as accepting her counsel regarding Anne's schooling.

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla is the authority figure over her young third cousin [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), whom she took into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) along with his twin sister. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) frequently tests Marilla's patience with his mischievous pranks and lies, forcing Marilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to punish and discipline him, though Marilla holds a genuine affection for him despite his misbehavior.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), +11 more_
